`@interface UIDataOverlayInteraction`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.core.data` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [UIDataOverlayInteraction.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/core/data/UIDataOverlayInteraction.java)

Whether an overlay receives the input and what it lets through, set in the interaction option of `@UIDataOverlay`.

## Description

An overlay that receives the input gets it before the screen when it is drawn above it.
The `cancel` options decide whether an input that a node of the overlay consumed still reaches the host application.

## Learn more

- [Overlays and popups](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/overlays-and-popups/#draw-an-overlay-above-the-screens-and-let-it-take-input)
- [Embedding JOID](/use/learn/running/embedding/)

## Elements

| Type | Element | Default | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| `boolean` | [active](#UIDataOverlayInteraction-element-active) | `false` | If `true`, the overlay receives the input. |
| `boolean` | [cancelClick](#UIDataOverlayInteraction-element-cancelClick) | `true` | If `true`, a mouse press, release or drag that the overlay consumed does not reach the host; if `false`, the host receives it too. |
| `boolean` | [cancelScroll](#UIDataOverlayInteraction-element-cancelScroll) | `true` | If `true`, a wheel turn that the overlay consumed does not reach the host. |
| `boolean` | [cancelKeyboard](#UIDataOverlayInteraction-element-cancelKeyboard) | `true` | If `true`, a key or a character that the overlay consumed does not reach the host. |
